_source: Major Disasters (420 subs), Spain high-speed train crash 3D reconstructed, 186K views, 14:14. Built-in browser 2026-11-20: 0-60 s played with the audio probe, then 160, 330, 410/413/417 (burst at the impact), 600, 640, 842 s; transcript panel counted (1,857 words, ~134 wpm; never copied). SAMPLED. Our own descriptions.

hook.firstFrame: black card, a big red condensed 'WARNING' and two short white paragraphs (distressing content, investigations open, no blame)
hook.firstLine: First, condolences to the families of everyone who died that day.

shots.picture: silent warning card, red condensed title, white body text
memorial card: one white sans line, condolences, the date in grey
real news drone footage of the wreck with broadcaster and police logos
dark 3D: track lines to a vanishing point, low-poly sphere trees, a small train; cyan outlined route tag; tiny mono header 'own 3D graphic, not to scale'
three wireframe server racks with green and red LEDs, a white pill with the distance
photo of the Madrid terminus platforms with red trains
3D chase down the dark track at cab height, a clock pill on screen
cab-height chase, catenary masts passing, the stopped train ahead under a green signal
cut to black at the moment of impact
real aerial footage of the derailed coaches and rescuers
the server racks again, one labelled as safety layer one
a signalling-panel screen in a dark 3D room: the line as green blocks, the two trains as red blocks, 'offline' in yellow
the empty dark track at dusk, slow push, no train

lines.gist: condolences and respect for victims and rescuers
a weekday morning, six trains on one stretch all stop at once by themselves
a computer fault switched off the safety system; one train waits, another is sent on
seventeen minutes later it runs into the back of the stopped train
minute-by-minute rebuild of the morning, clock on screen
the safety layers, each with a hole, lining up
earlier crashes on the same network
open questions, sources in the description, corrections promised

whyItWorks: Respect first: a warning and a memorial card before the story.
A clock pill ticks through the reconstruction so the viewer always knows the minute.
The impact is never shown: a cut to black, then real aftermath footage.
A Swiss-cheese chapter turns many causes into one picture (low-budget here: reused racks).
